scope: Finite structured-intent to opcode compilation with independent guard flags; not unrestricted text-to-code or general language modeling
model_selection: Best validation CE. Training reads train/validation only. No hyperparameter tuning after test.
primary_comparison: native-minus-flat semantic opcode prefix exact match on long split; group bootstrap95%; three seeds; no superiority claim if compute unmatched
denominator: All plans, positive and negative separately. Syntax emitter, gate and exact executor receive no neural credit. This semantic task alone does not close broad program-generation gates.
factorization: 2000 independent groups and guard-flipped twins, identical numbers; no parity-derived guards
long_test: 2000 new sequences length12-20, train4-7; compositional control is deterministic, not learned autoregressive memory
external_effects: No network/shell/clinical/public/paid effects; local journal simulation only
previous_results: 79.69/99.38/29.83 remain prior transcript-only, not recomputed R4 data
